entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A team of planeswalkers with a lasting commitment to protect the people of the Multiverse from threats that no one else can handle.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch and, with Chandra, takes down the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch and, with Nissa, weakens the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch and, with Gideon, takes down the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch and, with Jace, weakens the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan fought by the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan fought by the Gatewatch; its brood lineage is depicted by the colorless mana symbol.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demonic planeswalker opposed by the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The titans and broods, led by Ulamog and Kozilek, that the four planeswalkers fight.

events.summary: Gideon, Jace, Chandra and Nissa join forces against the Eldrazi titans Ulamog and Kozilek and the planeswalker Ob Nixilis, becoming the Gatewatch.
events.quote: They become the Gatewatch , a team with a lasting commitment to protect the people of the Multiverse from threats that no one else can handle.

events.summary: On the card Bonds of Mortality, Nissa and Jace weaken the Eldrazi titans Ulamog and Kozilek.
events.quote: In the first card, Nissa and Jace weaken the Eldrazi Titans, Ulamog, and Kozilek.

events.summary: On the card Fall of the Titans, Chandra and Gideon take both titans out.
events.quote: In the second one Chandra and Gideon take them both out.
